data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can take 50 tons total and leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. How about 10 tons each? That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick with it. I propose we all agree to that limit and review the catches together each month. John, what do you think?
